rv.q: Whatever you may think of the title, be assured it’s a wonderful show and a wonderful cast.
The only cast member fully inhabiting his character, Andrew Rannells actually reminds one of Jimmy Stewart who originated the role.

cn.t: Critics are split on this holiday radio play adaptation — one finds it exhilarating with a dazzling cast breathing life into the classic, while another is less convinced. The ensemble work earns the most praise.

lo.t: Opens 12 AM day before performance, closes 3 PM day before. Winners drawn at 10 AM and 3 PM.
lo.inst: Winners notified by email and have five hours to claim and purchase tickets online. Limit 2 tickets.

ru.inst: Available on the day of the performance. Limit 2 tickets. Cash or credit card.

sn.c: By row R the Mezzanine overhang hangs over about a third of the stage, and the shallow rake in rows R to T means heads in front can block the view.
sn.sh: Overhang and a shallow rake in the back rows

sn.lo: Orchestra, far sides, rows D to F
sn.c: The side Boxes jut out over the far aisle seats of the Left and Right Orchestra around rows D to F, blocking part of the view.
sn.sh: Side Boxes block far aisle seats near the front

sn.c: The Boxes above the side Orchestra sections have movable chairs, but they look at the stage from sharp angles and views can be very restricted.
sn.sh: Sharp angles and very restricted views

sn.lo: Center Mezzanine, rows C to F
sn.c: Center Mezzanine rows C to F have enough rake to see over heads, giving a raised, wide view at a good price.
sn.sh: Raised, wide view over heads at a good price

sn.c: The cheapest seats in the house are at the sides of the Left and Right Mezzanine, though the view there is a little more restricted.
sn.sh: Cheapest seats, with a slightly restricted view

sn.c: The middle of Mezzanine rows can be very cramped, so pick an aisle seat if you want more legroom.

vs.sum: One of Broadway's least comfortable theaters, with notoriously tight legroom and narrow seats. The lack of rake means tall patrons in front block your view. Restrooms are in the basement, creating long intermission lines. For legroom, target Row A or N in Orchestra.

acc.note: 6 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. No steps from sidewalk. Infrared devices available.
